summary: Revalidate historical replicated subject-reference failures once after a local schema upgrade

replay.detail: Normal startup admission rechecks retained invalid-replicated-claim records whose error identifies invalid-subject-reference, once per local schema digest. A missing completion marker also schedules one pass for stores opened by older builds. Original envelopes, record references, claim IDs, raw bytes and writer provenance remain unchanged; newly admitted claims use normal projection.

schema.detail: One local meta key records the schema digest after the retry pass completes. No tables, indexes, storage-version changes or signed data rewrites.

rules.detail: Signature verification, fleet membership, hashes, claim validation and checkpoint rules are unchanged. A schema identity schedules validation; it never grants admission.

compatibility.detail: Previously rejected references can become valid when the upgraded registry recognizes their subject family. Still-invalid references and malformed claims remain rejected; missing or forged signatures do not bypass normal admission holds. No coordinated upgrade is required for the retry mechanism.

downtime.detail: The first admission pass for a new local schema performs an indexed lookup of this narrow historical error class and revalidates matching envelopes through existing bounded writer transactions. Whole-backlog payload selection remains materialized and is not bounded-memory. Ordinary passes do not revalidate still-invalid references at the same schema identity; eligible historical receipts held for verified authority remain pending through the normal admission lifecycle, so later signatures can unblock them after restart.

manual.detail: Use the normal pinned-build upgrade and daemon startup lifecycle. Do not resend messages, replace records, edit SQLite, delete the retry marker or invoke manual replay to recover a retained reference rejection.

recovery.detail: The marker is local, rebuildable retry progress. Interrupted passes resume safely because completion is recorded only after normal admission finishes. Older builds ignore the marker but may still reject references they do not know; retain the pre-upgrade state and follow the standard rollback policy.
